description: Phase 4 (Send to Car) design-match fixes in app/src/main/java/dev/autobridge/browser/SendToCarSheet.kt (fixes 25-28 from the audit). Independent of FEAT-003 except in sequence; touches only SendToCarSheet.kt plus strings. Uses BrowserTheme tokens and BrowserIcon vectors.
steps: Fix 26 — Remove the segmented tab row (do this first, it simplifies the rest). In SendToCarSheet.kt: (a) delete the container.addView(tabRow()) call in render(); (b) delete the tabRow() and tab() methods and the Mode enum + 'private var mode = Mode.URL' field; (c) in render(), the current-page card was gated by 'if (mode == Mode.URL && url != null)' — change to just 'if (url != null)' so the current page always shows. Everything renders in one scroll with no tabs. Keep the input field, engine chooser, buttons, and queue list in the same order.

Fix 25 — 'Connected' pill (green) in header. In header(), add a status pill to the right of the 'Send to car' title (before the close X). Build a small rounded pill: a green dot + label. Read connection status from AutoBridgeSessionManager — check its SessionState.connected (the same state ControlScreen's OnTheCarCard reads via AutoBridgeSessionManager.SessionState). Add a constructor param `connected: () -> Boolean` to SendToCarSheet (callers in BrowserActivity pass a lambda reading AutoBridgeSessionManager session state) OR read it directly if the manager exposes a static/current accessor — verify how BrowserActivity obtains session state before choosing. When connected: green pill (BrowserTheme uses the ACCENT_ONLINE equivalent — use a GradientDrawable filled with a tint of green with a green dot) showing R.string.conn_connected_plain ('Connected'). When disconnected: a muted/grey pill showing R.string.bridge_controller_disconnected ('Android Auto not connected') or a shorter 'Not connected' (reuse R.string.conn_not_connected). Use existing color tokens only.

Fix 28 — Remove the '◉' radio glyph from current-page card. In currentPageCard(), delete the trailing TextView that renders text = "◉". The card stays a plain tappable row (setOnClickListener { if (onSendUrl(url)) shell.dismiss() } remains). The favicon placeholder and text column stay.

Fix 27 — Replace emoji glyphs with BrowserIcon vectors. (a) In primaryButton(), replace the TextView(text = "🚗") with an ImageView using iconDrawable(BrowserIcon.CAR, BrowserTheme.onPrimary) at SHEET_ICON_DP size (mirror how MoreActionsSheet.sendToCarButton uses tintedIcon(BrowserIcon.CAR, ...)). (b) In queueButton(), replace the TextView(text = "≡") with an ImageView using iconDrawable(BrowserIcon.ADD, BrowserTheme.accent) (ADD is the queue/add glyph used by the 'Add to queue' control elsewhere; MoreActionsSheet.carPairRow uses BrowserIcon.ADD for Add to queue). Keep the icon sizing/padding consistent with the sheet's other icons and the existing marginEnd/padding.

Add new EN strings to app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml if needed for the connected-pill content description (e.g. reuse existing conn_connected_plain / conn_not_connected — these already exist, so new strings may not be required). If any new string is added, add the TH equivalent to values-th/strings.xml.
Build and confirm all unit tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: No segmented 'Send URL / Search on car' tab row; everything shows in one scroll.
A connection-status pill appears in the header next to the title; green when connected, adapted (muted) when disconnected.
Current-page card no longer shows the ◉ radio glyph but remains tappable.
primaryButton shows the BrowserIcon.CAR vector; queueButton shows the BrowserIcon.ADD vector (no 🚗/≡ emoji).
No existing string renamed/removed; any added string present in both strings.xml files.
Only existing color tokens used; no new color/radius literals.
verification: grep SendToCarSheet.kt to confirm no 🚗, ≡, ◉ glyphs and no Mode/tabRow remain
findings: All four Phase 4 fixes (25-28) implemented in SendToCarSheet.kt plus BrowserActivity.kt wiring. Fix 26: removed the segmented tab row — deleted tabRow()/tab() methods, the Mode enum and the 'private var mode' field, dropped tabParams(), and the current-page card is now gated only on 'if (url != null)' so it always shows; everything renders in one scroll. Fix 25: added a 'connected' status pill in header() to the right of the title (before the close X). The pill is a rounded chip (radius from AutoUiSizes.TOUCH_TARGET_DP/2, no new literal) with a colored dot + label. Connection state is read via a new constructor param 'isConnected: () -> Boolean'; BrowserActivity passes { AutoBridgeSessionManager.current.connected } — the same SessionState.connected ControlScreen's OnTheCarCard reads. AutoBridgeSessionManager.current is a synchronous static accessor, so no listener/lifecycle wiring was needed. Connected uses BrowserTheme.secureBadge (the scheme's existing green/success token — M3 has no success role, and this is the ACCENT_ONLINE equivalent in the browser View color system), disconnected uses BrowserTheme.textSecondary (muted). The pill fill is an alpha-40 tint of that token (mirrors ControlScreen's StatusPill alpha-dimmed background). Labels reuse existing R.string.conn_connected_plain / conn_not_connected (both already present in EN + TH) so no new strings were added. Fix 28: removed the trailing '◉' TextView from currentPageCard(); the row stays tappable (onSendUrl click retained). Fix 27: primaryButton() '🚗' TextView replaced with an ImageView using iconDrawable(BrowserIcon.CAR, BrowserTheme.onPrimary) at SHEET_ICON_DP; queueButton() '≡' replaced with iconDrawable(BrowserIcon.ADD, BrowserTheme.accent) at SHEET_ICON_DP, both keeping marginEnd = shell.pad(). Only existing color/radius tokens used; no strings renamed. Build: ./gradlew testPersonalDebugUnitTest assemblePersonalDebug — BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 531 unit tests pass, APK assembled. grep confirms no 🚗/≡/◉ glyphs and no Mode/tabRow remain in SendToCarSheet.kt.
